headline: Cardi B's lawyers have reportedly ordered the maker of a viral AI sitcom that used her face and voice to take it down.
score_reason: Lowered from 2: the news dates from 30 Sep 2026 and rests on one outlet citing others.
importance_line: Performers whose faces and voices are copied by AI are the people most affected, then studios and video platforms that face likeness-rights questions, but only a takedown demand is reported and no court case.
summary: EURweb reports, citing Shine My Crown and a podcast from 30 Sep 2026, that lawyers for Cardi B told the creator of a viral AI-made 1990s-style sitcom, 'Cardi B Is the Nanny', to remove it, and that the creator reportedly agreed. EURweb stresses this is a reported takedown demand only, as no lawsuit or court filing has been found.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched page. Story first reported 30 Sep 2026, so not new today.
